description: HAL USART2 to an ESP-01 (ESP8266) at 115200: PB0 enables CH_PD, the boot ROM banner (74880 baud) is skipped up to 'ready', then ATE0, AT, AT+GMR, AT+CWMODE? and AT+CWJAP (ERROR: the lab has no Wi-Fi); report on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. USART2 PA2 -> ESP-01 RXD, PA3 <- ESP-01 TXD, 115200 8N1 (PCLK1 36 MHz: BRR 19 + 8/16 = 115384.6 baud, +0.16 %, as on real silicon); PB0 -> CH_PD (push-pull, low after reset); ESP-01 VCC 3.3 V; USART1 PA9 115200 8N1 report. After reset: 'ESP-01 test (USART2 115200 8N1, CH_PD on PB0)
', PB0 high, then every received line is discarded until 'ready' (the 74880-baud ROM banner arrives as garbage at 115200), up to 1.5 s: none -> 'no ready from the ESP-01 (CH_PD high? 3.3 V?)
' and the core sleeps. Else 'ready after T ms
' (T about 250 ms: the module boot), then one line per command (200 ms answer timeout): 'ATE0 -> OK', 'AT -> OK', 'AT+GMR -> AT version:1.7.4.0(...)' (first line of the version), 'AT+CWMODE? -> +CWMODE:1 OK', 'AT+CWJAP -> ERROR' (joining a network fails: Wi-Fi is not simulated), then 'esp01 ok
' when every answer matched, else 'esp01 FAILED
', then WFI.

circuit: ESP-01 module: not placed on this bench (the checks runner cannot place it; the AT dialogue is covered by tests/devices/comm-firmware.test.ts)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
